settings.heading: Storing and thawing
settings.text: Keep packs in the freezer at −18 °C for up to six months. Thaw one in the fridge overnight and use it within three days. Do not refreeze a thawed pack.

settings.heading: How much to feed
settings.text: Most adult dogs eat 2 to 3 % of their body weight a day; puppies and kittens eat more. The meal finder on the home page gives you a starting point.
